items.headline: Wind Advisory issued August 3 at 2:15PM AKDT until August 4 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Anchorage Hillside and along Seward Highway near Turnagain
Arm: Southeast winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 60 mph. For
West and South Anchorage, southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts
up to 40 to 50 mph. Weaker winds expected for midtown and downtown
Anchorage.

* WHERE...West and South Anchorage, along the Seward Highway near
the Turnagain Arm, and for the Hillside.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM AKDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects and a few
power outag
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM AKDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Gusty winds could blow around

outages may result.

items.headline: Flood Watch issued August 3 at 12:04PM AKDT until August 7 at 12:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is possible.

* WHERE...The following areas: Central Susitna Valley and Western
Susitna Valley. This includes Petersville, Cache Creek, Talkeetna,
and communities along the Yentna and Skwentna Rivers.

* WHEN...From Tuesday morning through Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Significant rainfall is expected in the Su
items.areas: Western Susitna Valley; Central Susitna Valley
items.instruction:

items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued August 3 at 9:12AM AKDT until August 4 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Water levels 1 to 3 feet above the highest high tide
line. The highest water levels will be Monday through Monday
night, before returning to more normal levels on Tuesday.

* WHERE...Yukon Delta Coast.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM AKDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Localized beach erosion may occur. At Hooper Bay,
water will approach the road to the airport but should not
inundate the airport or the road.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Prolonged southerly winds of 15 to 30 mph

items.instruction:
Precautions should be taken to protect property. Secure and move
items away from beaches.
